name: Verify email
when: Immediately after a customer creates an account, or requests a new confirmation email.
subject: Confirm your email address
delivery: Supabase Auth; activation must be independently verified

name: Account ready
when: After email verification has completed successfully.
subject: Your Artisan Mart account is ready
delivery: Prepared template; sending event is not connected by this release

name: Reset password
when: When a customer submits a password-reset request. Only send if an eligible account exists.
subject: Reset your Artisan Mart password
delivery: Supabase Auth; activation must be independently verified

name: Password changed
when: After a password change has completed successfully, never just after requesting a reset.
subject: Your Artisan Mart password was changed
delivery: Supabase Auth; activation must be independently verified

name: Confirm new email
when: When a signed-in customer requests an email change. Follow the configured old/new address confirmation policy.
subject: Confirm your new email address
delivery: Supabase Auth; activation must be independently verified

name: Order confirmed
when: Only after the payment processor confirms successful payment and the order is committed.
subject: Your order is confirmed · # {{order_number}}
delivery: Prepared template; sending event is not connected by this release

name: Payment unsuccessful
when: After a verified failed payment attempt. Do not describe an unpaid order as confirmed.
subject: Payment was not completed · # {{order_number}}
delivery: Prepared template; sending event is not connected by this release

name: Order shipped
when: After a real shipment is recorded. Include carrier and tracking only when those values are available.
subject: Your order is on its way · # {{order_number}}
delivery: Prepared template; sending event is not connected by this release

name: Order cancelled
when: Only after customer service has actually confirmed cancellation. A cancellation request alone does not trigger this message.
subject: Your order was cancelled · # {{order_number}}
delivery: Prepared template; sending event is not connected by this release

name: Refund processed
when: After the payment processor confirms the refund. Use the actual refunded amount, including for partial refunds.
subject: Refund processed · # {{order_number}}
delivery: Prepared template; sending event is not connected by this release

name: Inquiry received
when: After the contact form inquiry has been stored and accepted successfully.
subject: We received your inquiry · {{ticket_number}}
delivery: Prepared template; sending event is not connected by this release
